ai.title: RAG-Enhanced LLMs for Interactive Explainability in Clinical Decision Support Systems
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.09232v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in high-risks decision-making systems across domains such as healthcare, finance, and the judicial system. As reliance on predictive models grows, so does the demand for Explainable AI (XAI) to ensure transparency, trust, and interpretability. However, existing XAI approaches often fail to present explanations in a format accessible to domain experts, limiting their practical utility. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently emerged as a bridge between complex models and end-users, offering natural language explanations. Yet, their use introduces new risks, including hallucinated outputs and lack of source traceability. To address these challenges, we propose a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) that not only combines standard predictive models with XAI techniques but also incorporates a Retrieval-Augmented Generation module as an interactive enhancer. This module grounds explanations in verified medical knowledge, reformulates technical outputs into a human-like format, and enables users-such as clinicians-to actively query the system. By fostering an interactive, human-in-the-loop environment, our approach empowers domain experts to explore model decisions, contextualize explanations, and build trust in AI-assisted diagnostics. The study concludes with preliminary experiments validating the proposed methodology.
ai.summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in high-risks decision-making systems across domains such as healthcare, finance, and the judicial system.…

ai.title: AttentionSwitch: Jailbreak Defense for LLMs via Joint Learning of Sparse Attention-Head Selection and Scaling
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.08752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, yet they remain susceptible to jailbreak attacks that circumvent safety mechanisms and elicit harmful or unintended outputs. Although safety can be improved through model fine-tuning, such approaches can be computationally expensive and may degrade previously acquired capabilities through catastrophic forgetting. Recent jailbreak defenses have therefore explored targeted interventions on specific model components associated with unsafe behavior. However, existing approaches typically decouple two inherently related decisions: where to intervene and how to modify the selected components. Such sequential optimization may be suboptimal because the optimal intervention location can depend on the intervention applied there, and vice versa. In this work, we introduce AttentionSwitch, the first jailbreak defense to jointly optimize intervention sites and strengths within a frozen LLM. Specifically, AttentionSwitch learns a sparse set of attention heads together with query-conditioned multiplicative scaling factors, allowing the outputs of the selected heads to be either attenuated or amplified without altering the directions of their representations. Across popular language models and jailbreak attacks, AttentionSwitch outperforms existing defenses, with particularly strong results when training data is scarce.

ai.title: Evaluation of a Multi-Link Machine Learning Approach for Rainfall Detection Using Satellite Microwave Links
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.09156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The impacts of climate change have increased the need for reliable real-time rainfall monitoring systems. This study investigates rainfall detection using a network of opportunistic sensors based on satellite microwave links (SMLs) combined with machine learning (ML) classifiers. Two models, a random forest (RF) and a convolutional neural network (CNN), were trained on aggregated SML data, including information from neighboring links. The results demonstrate that leveraging information from multiple links substantially enhances the detection of both wet and dry periods compared to single-link approaches. Moreover, the RF model consistently provides a more stable and reliable trade-off than CNN, improving rainfall detection and reducing misclassifications overall, with particularly strong performance during harsh weather conditions. The study spanned up to 32 rainy days between 2021 and 2024.
ai.summary: The impacts of climate change have increased the need for reliable real-time rainfall monitoring systems.

ai.title: Guardrail Erosion in Domain Fine-Tuned Large Language Models: A Paired Audit of Knowledge-Centric Abstention in Biomedical LLMs
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.08780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The number of domain fine-tuned models, particularly in the biomedical domain, is rapidly expanding. Fine-tuning promises high-performing models at a fraction of the cost of training a base model, but it can also produce unintended behavioral changes. Multiple studies have shown that safety guardrails can erode with fine-tuning, yet large-scale studies across model architectures, data mixtures, and fine-tuning methodologies remain limited. Where prior work in this space has studied value-centric refusal, this work focuses on knowledge-centric abstention. We audit 25 biomedical domain fine-tuned large language models against 11 paired base checkpoints on MedAbstain and ClinDet-Bench to evaluate the impact of fine-tuning on knowledge-centric abstention. We find that defined appropriate abstention measured by these benchmarks, already low in base models (median 8.3% on MedAbstain), falls further after fine-tuning (median 4.2%, decreasing in 21 of 25 pairs on MedAbstain), and that the magnitude and direction of change are heterogeneous across pairs. These results motivate fine-tuning methods that improve domain-specific capability while preserving appropriate caution.
ai.summary: The number of domain fine-tuned models, particularly in the biomedical domain, is rapidly expanding.

ai.title: Beyond Truncation? Entailment-Licensed Elision and the Limits of Semantic Preservation in LLM Decoding
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.08975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) answer at greater length than a request needs. We ask whether a training-free controller inside the decoding loop can remove that surplus while preserving content, judged against the simplest possible baseline: truncating the model's own answer to the same length. An entropy-gated logits processor removes 25.5-34.9% of tokens on MT-Bench development questions and 19.9-34.2% on a sealed test split within pre-registered BERTScore non-inferiority margins, yet we prove and confirm by audit that its output is always a prefix of the unmodified answer: the saving is truncation. A survey of 23 training-free mechanism families finds none that selects content better than truncation without oracle labels. We therefore introduce Entailment-Licensed In-Decoding Elision (ELIDE), which, at each sentence boundary, withholds a span from the reader only when a natural-language inference model judges it entailed by the text already shown, while leaving the model's generation unchanged. ELIDE beats matched-length truncation on three model families, but reading 936 of its elisions on 670 public prompts shows that 59% harm the answer, a failure that no automatic measure detects. Scoping the licence to its discourse unit reduces the harmful share to about one elision in ten on two fresh tests.
ai.summary: Instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) answer at greater length than a request needs.

ai.title: Language as Trait, Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.09768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely. We test whether such differences change how other agents judge and act, using the LURK Werewolf framework, which separates each utterance's speech-act predicate from its natural-language realization. We rewrite only the realization, check that the game content is preserved, and replay each game day from saved checkpoints against a re-sampled control. We vary linguistic range consistently across a speaker's messages and politeness strategy per utterance. Across 30 games and 4,335 replays, neither manipulation changes the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction for multiple comparisons; the largest uncorrected effect is that shifting range away from a neutral paraphrase changes about 4 percentage points more of the other players' votes. In natural play, 88% of face-threatening speech is bald on-record regardless of role.
ai.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely.…

ai.title: Democracy Assistance: State Department Should Improve Congressional Notification of Its Use of Certain Legal Authorities
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found Federal law contains certain provisions, known as notwithstanding authorities, that allow agencies to provide funding that would otherwise be restricted. Historically, the annual appropriations act has required agencies to notify Congress if they intend to use a notwithstanding authority to provide assistance in countries where U.S. law prohibits U.S. funding. In fiscal years (FY) 2023 and 2024, the joint explanatory statement (JES) accompanying the act included additional directions for providing such notifications. In July 2025 the Secretary of State announced that USAID had ceased to implement foreign assistance. State assumed certain former USAID functions, including some democracy programs, and will submit congressional notifications related to future democracy assistance. While Congress has not included a JES with directions for providing information on notwithstanding authorities with every appropriations act, it did so in fiscal year 2026 and may continue to do so in the future. GAO’s review of 37 State congressional notifications for FYs 2023 and 2024 funding found that 36 of the notifications do not address one of three criteria, specified in Section 7015(c) of the FYs 2023 and 2024 appropriations acts or in their JESs, for reporting the use of notwithstanding authorities. ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found Department of Homeland Security (DHS) detention facility inspections have changed at the same time that the number of immigration detention facilities and the size of the detained population have increased. From April 2025 to April 2026, following a January 2025 Executive Order, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) added over 40 detention facilities that detain noncitizens for over 72 hours. The average daily population of detained noncitizens grew by over 50 percent, to 61,817 individuals, over the timeframe. From fiscal year 2024 to July 2026, three of the four DHS entities that conducted inspections changed the frequency (decreased or increased) or stopped conducting inspections. Changes to Inspections Conducted by DHS Entities from Fiscal Year (FY) 2024 to July 2026 ICE relies on these inspections to identify deficiencies in its facilities and ensure compliance with its detention standards. However, the frequency of inspections has in some cases decreased, there is an increased reliance on self-inspections, and processes for these inspections have changed. ICE has not used evidence, such as data on deficiencies identified through inspections and performance information such as the extent to which facilities are in compliance with their contracts, to determine the effects of these recent changes on facility conditions. ai.source_name: 歐盟執委會 數位政策
ai.via: 歐盟執委會 數位政策
ai.raw_summary: Commission preliminarily finds TikTok’s ‘For You’ feed in breach of Digital Services Act for harmful ‘rabbit holes’ effect Anonymous (not verified) Fri, 11/06/2026 - 12:09 The European Commission has preliminarily found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act (DSA) for the so-called ‘rabbit hole effect’ of its recommender system. TikTok's ‘For You' feed shows users a continuous stream of personalised videos, even when those are related to mental health struggles and body image. The more a user interacts with a certain type of content, the more TikTok's ‘For You' feed algorithm recommends similar content. This design can be harmful when such endless and repeated exposure involves, for example, content about sadness, isolation or body image. These ‘rabbit holes' can have a detrimental impact on users' mental health, especially that of vulnerable adults and minors. These preliminary findings focus on both risk assessment and mitigation measures. trade.title: 經濟部貿易救濟審議會就我對韓國及中國大陸非方向性電磁鋼品反傾銷案與對中國大陸特定鋁箔落日調查案作成產業損害之肯定認定
trade.source_name: 經濟部國際貿易署 新聞
trade.via: 經濟部國際貿易署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 經濟部今（9）日召開貿易救濟審議會，會中就我國對韓國及中國大陸冷軋扁軋非方向性電磁鋼品反傾銷案，以及對中國大陸特定鋁箔課徵反傾銷稅屆滿5年之落日調查案等2案之產業損害調查結果進行審議，前者最後認定國內產業遭受實質損害；後者認定國內產業損害可能因停止課徵反傾銷稅而繼續或再發生。 經濟部表示，就電磁鋼品案調查發現，韓國及中國大陸涉案貨物進口量大幅增加且持續降價，自112年起以低於國產品價格銷售，國內產業為維持競爭力被迫跟進減價，惟因減價幅度不及涉案傾銷貨物而流失客戶，導致生產量、產能利用率、內銷量、市場占有率等經濟指標全面下滑，並自113年起內銷出現虧損且逐步擴大。雖然國內產業114年相關經濟指標一度改善，但115年上半年再度轉弱，顯示涉案傾銷貨物進口已對國內產業造成顯著不利影響。 另針對中國大陸特定鋁箔落日調查案，調查發現，課徵反傾銷稅期間涉案貨物進口量雖有減少，但仍以低價與國產品競爭，使得國內產業營運狀況略有好轉後又再度惡化。復考量中國大陸鋁箔產能過剩且出口能力強勁，加上越來越多國家對其鋁箔採行貿易救濟措施或提高關稅，已嚴重限縮其外銷市場。若我國停止課徵反傾銷稅，涉案貨物可能再度低價大量出口至鄰近且其已建立行銷通路的我國市場。在國內需求尚未好轉、產業體質仍然脆弱的情況下，可能使我國特定鋁箔產業之損害繼續或再發生。 經濟部表示，上述2案產業損害認定結果將通知財政部，並由該部提交關稅稅率審議小組審議是否課徵及繼續課徵反傾銷稅。該2案之產業損害調查報告公開版可於今年12月9日起至貿易署網站（網址：https://www.trade.gov.tw/）「經貿往來」/「我國採行之貿易救濟措施」/「案件調查」項下之「調查報告」下載。 貿易署發言人：胡副署長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7109、02-2397-7178、0966-525-106 業務聯絡人：綜合企劃組邱組長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7361

trade.title: 「雙11」跨境網購請小心，貨品輸入規定要認清！
trade.source_name: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.via: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 「雙11」購物季是跨境網購的大旺季，財政部關務署提醒民眾切勿錯認「網站買得到就能合法進口」！倘若商品屬於輸入管制貨品，必須取得貨品主管機關許可文件才能進口，海關呼籲民眾跨境網購前務必先確認貨品是否涉及輸入規定，否則可能因違規而受罰。 財政部關務署表示，跨境網購商品種類繁多，常見如應施檢疫之動植物產品（如肉乾、種子）、醫療器材及藥品（如輪椅、玻尿酸）、電信管制射頻器材（如無線耳機）、應施檢驗商品（如玩具、行動電源）及管制輸入大陸物品（如螺螄粉、花生）等，進口時均應分別遵守農業部動植物防疫檢疫署、衛生福利部食品藥物管理署、國家通訊傳播委員會、經濟部標準檢驗局及經濟部國際貿易署等貨品主管機關的輸入規定辦理。因相關規定分散於不同主管機關，民眾往往不清楚哪些商品需要事先申請許可，一不小心就可能觸法。 該署說明，為提醒跨境網購民眾留意貨品輸入規定，已依立法院林委員岱樺質詢建議，彙整各貨品主管機關提供常見涉及輸入規定貨品資料，請關貿網路股份有限公司於「EZ Way 易利委」APP首頁及預先委任畫面，今年11月3日前建置「網購貨物常見涉輸入規定查詢參考」功能。民眾只需輸入貨品關鍵字，就能查詢相關輸入規定、主管機關聯絡資訊及注意事項；為使民眾更容易理解，再以顏色區分，其中，紅色代表禁止輸入或須事先取得輸入許可、黃色則代表限量內可免申請輸入許可，超過限量就須事先申請，讓民眾一目了然。 關務署進一步表示，為滿足民眾查詢其他商品的需求，透過EZ Way APP「AI貨品稅則查詢」連結至該署「貨品歸屬稅則查詢系統」，方便查詢貨品稅則稅率、輸入規定及主管機關等詳細資訊。除了透過EZ Way APP查詢，民眾亦可利用關港貿單一窗口「(GC473)貨品輸出入查詢」網頁查詢貨品輸出入規定，該網頁以貨品類型分類（如食品、藥品、農產品等），提供民眾更全面查詢貨品輸出入相關規定的服務。 關務署最後提醒，「網購先查清，收貨更安心！」跨境網購除了比價格、看評價，更要確認商品能不能合法進口。尤其同一貨物可能涉及多個貨品主管機關輸入規定，必須全數符合始得進口，民眾如有疑問可先洽詢貨品主管機關，避免因不諳法規而導致貨物延遲通關，甚至面臨貨物退運或遭裁罰等情形。該署呼籲切勿聽信境外劣質業者不實廣告，唯有事前查明規定、誠實申報，方可享受便捷安全之通關服務。 新聞稿聯絡人：陳科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2521

trade.title: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office: Patent Backlog Reduction Efforts Pose Risks to Examiner Retention and Examination Quality
trade.raw_summary: What GAO Found The backlog of unexamined patent applications awaiting an initial decision from the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) rose to about 838,000 applications in January 2025. In September 2025, the USPTO announced a goal to reduce the backlog to under 599,000 applications but did not specify a time frame for reaching it. The backlog was last at that level in 2020. To reduce the backlog, the USPTO is requiring patent examiners to review more applications, has decreased examiner training, and has expanded the use of AI patent search tools. As of August 2026, the USPTO reduced the backlog to about 756,000 applications, but average applicant wait times for a final patentability decision had increased by 11 percent since January 2025. GAO’s analysis found that, even with examiners doing more work, the USPTO is unlikely to reduce the backlog to under 599,000 patent applications before 2031 without lowering examiner attrition (see figure). The examiner attrition rate increased from 2.9 percent in fiscal year 2020 to 7.6 percent in fiscal year 2025. The agency is seeking to hire more examiners, but if high examiner attrition continues, it will affect the USPTO’s ability to reduce the backlog. As of August 2026, the 12-month examiner attrition rate was 7.6 percent.
